synopsis: Press out the pieces to build your own model of the brand new ship from Star Wars: Rogue One . Comes with mini book full of facts about the ships and characters from the new movie. Set before Star Wars: A New Hope , Rogue One follows a rag-tag group of rebel commandos who must steal the plans to the Empire's new superweapon, the Death Star. This standalone story transports fans to unseen corners of the Star Wars universe and strange new planets not to mention an encounter with a familiar adversary, Darth Vader. Have you collected all the Star Wars: Rogue One books? Star Wars Rogue One Book and Model: Make Your Own U-wing Star Wars Rogue One: Art of Colouring Star Wars Rogue One: Mission Files Star Wars Rogue One: Profiles and Poster Book
title: Rogue One Book and Model
